name: Almost Heaven Shenandoah 4-6 Person Barrel Sauna, 7x10 ft. w/ Changing Room
description: Please note: Due to the size of the Shenandoah, it will ship via a flatbed truck and will not fit on a liftgate. This means that you will be responsible for offloading the sauna. We recommend gathering 3-4 people to offload the sauna piece by piece or renting a forklift. Alternatively, you can add a Driver Offload service at checkout if you would like a hands-off offloading experience. Almost Heaven Shenandoah 7'x10' DIY Barrel Sauna Kit With Changing Room Due to the size of the Shenandoah, specialized flatbed shipping is required. Please anticipate this shipping anywhere from 6-8 weeks from the date of order. Rounding out at 10 feet long, the Shenandoah is the ultimate barrel sauna! The interior is divided into two spaces: a four-foot changing room and an six-foot sauna room. The diameter is seven feet, putting the total measurements at 7’x10’. Just looking at the Shenandoah, you can picture the sauna parties to come—the attached changing room adds an element of privacy, and the sauna room boasts plenty of space for up to four people. The Harvia 8 kW electric heater will have the room nice and toasty at 180ºF in an hour or delayed up to eight hours. Sequestered in your backyard, lodge, or mountain cabin, the Shenandoah will bring you relaxation for years to come. Features All glass features are tempered Two-room configuration Changing room Sauna room holds up to four people Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Best-in-class heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Sauna room holds up to six people Wood-burning or electric heater options Standard heater: 8kW, 240V, 40-amp electrical requirement, hardwire connect Heater upgrade: M3 wood stove with chimney installation kit or Harvia KIP80W with Xenio CX170 WiFi control panel Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled Size 84"W x 120"D x 89"H Sauna Room Interior Dimensions: 83"W x 72"D x 83"H Changing Room Interior Dimensions: 83"W x 48"D x 83"H Sauna Room Bench Size: 72"L x 20"W x 22"H Changing Room Bench Size: 48"L x 20"W x 22" Shipping dimensions: 144”L x 48”W x 55”H Shipping weight: 1750lbs Assembled weight: 1600lbs Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Lumber type: Choose between three different types of solid lumber. Rustic fir is light in color, with small knots creating a unique pattern on each piece. Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. Clear cedar is premium lumber, with knots noticeably absent. All three lumber options are 1 ⅜” thick to insulate the sauna room. Vista rear window: Open the barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the vista rear window. This 20” x 36” piece of 3/8” glass sits on the back end barrel, above the electric heater. Door style: Outfit your sauna with one of the following four door options: deluxe glass, fading glass, wood with a window, or all-wood. Heater: The Shenandoah comes standard with an 8kW electric, and you can upgrade it to an electric 8kW Harvia KIP80W with Xenio CX170 panel and WiFi controls, or a wood-burning Harvia M3 heater with a chimney kit. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping & Assembly The Shenandoah will ship via a flatbed truck. Lead time is 3-6 weeks. Mid-level handyman and assembly skills are recommended for this sauna. Minimal sawing or modifying certain components may be necessary during the assembly process. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6-8 hours. It is recommended that you review the installation manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity.
